info.name: TogetherLearn — Full E2E QA Suite
info.description:
One-click complete E2E test suite. Run with Collection Runner → covers all 9 microservices, 60+ endpoints, auth flows, multi-user scenarios, and error cases.

Prerequisites: All services running (API Gateway :8080), PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, MinIO.

How to run:
1. Import collection
2. Click 'Run collection'
3. Iterations = 1, delay = 300ms
4. Run — all IDs auto-wire between requests.
